Become a Member Book a Tour The community for scaling entrepreneurs. Many OKC resources do one thing well: funding, acceleration, space. The Verge connects you to all of them: Connections, Mentorship, Programming, and Workspace. As a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, we help scaling entrepreneurs accelerate their business and drive economic impact in Oklahoma City. The Verge is OKC’s home base for entrepreneurs at every stage of the journey. We connect people who are building something to the resources, relationships, and community they need to actually make it.
